preconditions.description: The length of word s must be between 1 and 100 characters.
The length of word t must be between 1 and 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both words s and t must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if t == s[::-1] else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: If t is the reverse of s, output 'YES'; otherwise, output 'NO'.
